verses.en: And the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth: and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.
verses.pt: O quinto anjo tocou a sua trombeta, e vi uma estrela que do céu caíra sobre a terra; e foi-lhe dada a chave do poço do abismo.
verses.en_web: The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.
verses.en_bbe: And at the sounding of the fifth angel I saw a star falling from heaven to the earth: and there was given to him the key of the great deep.

verses.en: And he opened the bottomless pit; and there arose a smoke out of the pit, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit.
verses.pt: E abriu o poço do abismo, e subiu fumaça do poço, como fumaça de uma grande fornalha; e com a fumaça do poço escureceram-se o sol e o ar.
verses.en_web: He opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a burning furnace. The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.
verses.en_bbe: And he made the great deep open and a smoke went up from it, like the smoke of a great oven; and the sun and the air were made dark because of the smoke.

verses.en: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth: and unto them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
verses.pt: Da fumaça saíram gafanhotos sobre a terra; e foi-lhes dado poder, como o que têm os escorpiões da terra.
verses.en_web: Then out of the smoke came locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
verses.en_bbe: And from the smoke locusts came out on the earth; and power was given them, like the power of scorpions.

verses.en: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads.
verses.pt: Foi-lhes dito que não fizessem dano à erva da terra, nem a verdura alguma, nem a árvore alguma, mas somente aos homens que não têm na fronte o selo de Deus.
verses.en_web: They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who don’t have God’s seal on their foreheads.
verses.en_bbe: And they were ordered to do no damage to the grass of the earth, or any green thing, or any tree, but only to such men as have not the mark of God on their brows.

verses.en: And to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment was as the torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man.
verses.pt: Foi-lhes permitido, não que os matassem, mas que por cinco meses os atormentassem. E o seu tormento era semelhante ao tormento do escorpião, quando fere o homem.
verses.en_web: They were given power, not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion, when it strikes a person.
verses.en_bbe: And orders were given them not to put them to death, but to give them great pain for five months: and their pain was as the pain from the wound of a scorpion.

verses.en: And in those days shall men seek death, and shall not find it; and shall desire to die, and death shall flee from them.
verses.pt: Naqueles dias os homens buscarão a morte, e de modo algum a acharão; e desejarão morrer, e a morte fugirá deles.
verses.en_web: In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. They will desire to die, and death will flee from them.
verses.en_bbe: And in those days men will be hoping for death, and it will not come to them; and they will have a great desire for death, and death will go in flight from them.

verses.en: And the shapes of the locusts were like unto horses prepared unto battle; and on their heads were as it were crowns like gold, and their faces were as the faces of men.
verses.pt: A aparência dos gafanhotos era semelhante à de cavalos aparelhados para a guerra; e sobre as suas cabeças havia como que umas coroas semelhantes ao ouro; e os seus rostos eram como rostos de homens.
verses.en_web: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people’s faces.
verses.en_bbe: And the forms of the locusts were like horses made ready for war; and on their heads they had crowns like gold, and their faces were as the faces of men.

verses.en: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.
verses.pt: Tinham cabelos como cabelos de mulheres, e os seus dentes eram como os de leões.
verses.en_web: They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.
verses.en_bbe: And they had hair like the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.

verses.en: And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle.
verses.pt: Tinham couraças como couraças de ferro; e o ruído das suas asas era como o ruído de carros de muitos cavalos que correm ao combate.
verses.en_web: They had breastplates, like breastplates of iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of chariots, or of many horses rushing to war.
verses.en_bbe: And they had breastplates like iron, and the sound of their wings was as the sound of carriages, like an army of horses rushing to the fight.

verses.en: And they had tails like unto scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power was to hurt men five months.
verses.pt: Tinham caudas com ferrões, semelhantes às caudas dos escorpiões; e nas suas caudas estava o seu poder para fazer dano aos homens por cinco meses.
verses.en_web: They have tails like those of scorpions, and stings. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.
verses.en_bbe: And they have pointed tails like scorpions; and in their tails is their power to give men wounds for five months.

verses.en: And they had a king over them, which is the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon, but in the Greek tongue hath his name Apollyon.
verses.pt: Tinham sobre si como rei o anjo do abismo, cujo nome em hebraico é Abadom e em grego Apoliom.
verses.en_web: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is “Abaddon”, but in Greek, he has the name “Apollyon”.
verses.en_bbe: They have over them as king the angel of the great deep: his name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in the Greek language Apollyon.

verses.en: One woe is past; and, behold, there come two woes more hereafter.
verses.pt: Passado é já um ai; eis que depois disso vêm ainda dois ais.
verses.en_web: The first woe is past. Behold, there are still two woes coming after this.
verses.en_bbe: The first Trouble is past: see, there are still two Troubles to come.

verses.en: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God,
verses.pt: O sexto anjo tocou a sua trombeta; e ouvi uma voz que vinha das quatro pontas do altar de ouro que estava diante de Deus,
verses.en_web: The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,
verses.en_bbe: And at the sounding of the sixth angel a voice came to my ears from the horns of the gold altar which is before God,

verses.en: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet, Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates.
verses.pt: a qual dizia ao sexto anjo, que tinha a trombeta: Solta os quatro anjos que se acham presos junto do grande rio Eufrates.
verses.en_web: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!”
verses.en_bbe: Saying to the sixth angel who had the horn, Make free the four angels who are chained at the great river Euphrates.

verses.en: And the four angels were loosed, which were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, for to slay the third part of men.
verses.pt: E foram soltos os quatro anjos que haviam sido preparados para aquela hora e dia e mês e ano, a fim de matarem a terça parte dos homens.
verses.en_web: The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one third of mankind.
verses.en_bbe: And the four angels were made free, who were ready for the hour and day and month and year, that they might put to death a third part of men.

verses.en: And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand: and I heard the number of them.
verses.pt: O número dos exércitos dos cavaleiros era de duas miríades de miríades; pois ouvi o número deles.
verses.en_web: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million. I heard the number of them.
verses.en_bbe: And the number of the armies of the horsemen was twice ten thousand times ten thousand: the number of them came to my ears.

verses.en: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.
verses.pt: E assim vi os cavalos nesta visão: os que sobre eles estavam montados tinham couraças de fogo, e de jacinto, e de enxofre; e as cabeças dos cavalos eram como cabeças de leões; e de suas bocas saíam fogo, fumaça e enxofre.
verses.en_web: Thus I saw the horses in the vision, and those who sat on them, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the horses’ heads resembled lions’ heads. Out of their mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.
verses.en_bbe: And so I saw the horses in the vision, and those who were seated on them, having breastplates of fire and glass and of burning stone: and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths came fire and smoke and a smell of burning.

verses.en: By these three was the third part of men killed, by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone, which issued out of their mouths.
verses.pt: Por estas três pragas foi morta a terça parte dos homens, isto é, pelo fogo, pela fumaça e pelo enxofre, que saíam das suas bocas.
verses.en_web: By these three plagues were one third of mankind killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.
verses.en_bbe: By these evils a third part of men was put to death, by the fire, and the smoke, and the burning smell which came out of their mouths.

verses.en: For their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails were like unto serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.
verses.pt: Porque o poder dos cavalos estava nas suas bocas e nas suas caudas. Porquanto as suas caudas eram semelhantes a serpentes, e tinham cabeças, e com elas causavam dano.
verses.en_web: For the power of the horses is in their mouths, and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads, and with them they harm.
verses.en_bbe: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails: because their tails are like snakes, and have heads, and with them they give wounds.

verses.en: And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship devils, and idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:
verses.pt: Os outros homens, que não foram mortos por estas pragas, não se arrependeram das obras das suas mãos, para deixarem de adorar aos demônios, e aos ídolos de ouro, de prata, de bronze, de pedra e de madeira, que nem podem ver, nem ouvir, nem andar.
verses.en_web: The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn’t repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn’t worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood; which can’t see, hear, or walk.
verses.en_bbe: And the rest of the people, who were not put to death by these evils, were not turned from the works of their hands, but went on giving worship to evil spirits, and images of gold and silver and brass and stone and wood which have no power of seeing or hearing or walking:

verses.en: Neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.
verses.pt: Também não se arrependeram dos seus homicídios, nem das suas feitiçarias, nem da sua prostituição, nem dos seus furtos.
verses.en_web: They didn’t repent of their murders, their sorceries, their sexual immorality, or their thefts.
verses.en_bbe: And they had no regret for putting men to death, or for their use of secret arts, or for the evil desires of the flesh, or for taking the property of others.
